plan.notes: Transcribed from the official SCC 'Surveying/Geomatics Certificate' program map, Catalog 2026-27, published May 27, 2026 (mapmaker.losrios.edu/Maps/7586/PublishedPdf). Certificate of Achievement (grade of C or better in each course). Official Total Units: 26-27; this seed models the first-listed/recommended path at the low end = 12+11+3 = 26 units (SURVY 311 at 3 units). Semester sums verified against the map's 12 / 11-12 / 3 headers. Choice slot: ME SURVY 311 / SURVY 360 — Major Elective (3-4 units, modeled at 3). SURVY 311 prerequisite: EDT 310 with a grade of C or better (documented, not encoded — it applies only to the SURVY 311 option). Sequencing prereqs per map: SURVY 320 requires SURVY 300 (or equivalent); SURVY 352 requires SURVY 350; SURVY 340 requires SURVY 320. tccns mirrors SCC local course codes (California community colleges do not use TCCNS).
